focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即 中国出口企业需加速碳数据合规布局
focus.summary: 2026年9月15日，距离欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期结束仅剩不足四个月。根据规则，2026年起进口商须购买CBAM证书，覆盖钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力及氢六大行业。中国出口企业面临直接与间接排放数据的申报压力，若无法提供经核查的碳排放数据，将按默认值被征收更高费用。建议企业立即梳理对欧出口产品碳足迹，建立内部碳核算体系，并与欧盟进口商确认数据传递机制，以降低合规成本。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司 · 2026.09.15
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Must Accelerate Carbon Data Compliance
focus.summary_en: As of September 15, 2026, less than four months remain before the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period concludes. From 2026, importers must purchase CBAM certificates, covering six sectors: iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity, and hydrogen. Chinese exporters face pressure to report direct and indirect emissions data; failure to provide verified carbon data will result in higher default-value charges. Companies should immediately map the carbon footprint of EU-bound products, establish internal carbon accounting systems, and confirm data transmission mechanisms with EU importers to reduce compliance costs.

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭首例认可中国法院商事判决 跨境执行路径进一步拓宽
case.summary: 近期，新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）在一起中新建材贸易合同纠纷中，依据《选择法院协议公约》及互惠原则，首次认可并执行中国内地法院作出的商事金钱判决。该案明确：只要中国法院判决符合正当程序且不违反新加坡公共政策，即可在普通法框架下获得执行。此案为中新两国跨境债权追索提供了新路径，也提示中国企业在对外合同中优先约定新加坡法院管辖或选择《选择法院协议公约》缔约国法院，以增强判决可执行性。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭 · 2026年第三季度
case.title_en: SICC Recognises Chinese Commercial Judgment for First Time, Broadening Cross-Border Enforcement
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) recently recognised and enforced, for the first time, a monetary commercial judgment rendered by a mainland Chinese court in a China-Singapore construction materials dispute, relying on the Hague Choice of Court Convention and principles of reciprocity. The ruling confirms that Chinese judgments satisfying due process and not offending Singapore public policy may be enforced under common law. This offers a new avenue for cross-border debt recovery between the two countries and suggests Chinese enterprises should consider designating Singapore courts or courts of Convention states in their contracts to enhance enforceability.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Commercial Court · Q3 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地 涉外企业数据出境迎来便利化通道
policy.summary: 2026年9月，粤港澳大湾区推出跨境数据流动便利化措施，允许符合条件的企业在“数据出境负面清单”外，通过安全评估或标准合同之外的新路径向港澳传输数据。新规覆盖金融、贸易、物流、医疗等关键领域，企业可申请“白名单”资格，享受简化申报流程。此举旨在降低大湾区企业跨境经营的数据合规成本，同时为涉外企业构建更可预期的数据出境环境。建议相关企业评估自身数据资产，提前准备白名单申请材料。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026年9月
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules in Greater Bay Area Offer Streamlined Channel for Foreign-Related Firms
policy.summary_en: In September 2026, the Greater Bay Area introduced facilitation measures for cross-border data flows, allowing eligible enterprises to transfer data to Hong Kong and Macao via a new pathway beyond security assessments or standard contracts, except for items on the negative list. Covering key sectors such as finance, trade, logistics, and healthcare, the rules enable companies to apply for whitelist status and benefit from simplified filing procedures. This aims to reduce data compliance costs for GBA businesses and create a more predictable environment for outbound data transfers. Companies should assess their data assets and prepare whitelist applications in advance.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · September 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围 中国出海企业须重构投资架构
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部近期拟将对外投资审查范围扩展至人工智能、量子计算及高超声速等领域的更多交易类型，并强化对“明知”标准的执法。中国出海企业若通过第三国子公司对美投资或与美国主体设立合资企业，可能触发申报义务。建议企业：一、对现有及拟议交易进行穿透式排查，识别敏感技术和最终受益人；二、在交易文件中加入“监管变化”条款，明确因审查导致交易受阻的责任分担；三、提前与专业顾问设计替代架构，如利用新加坡、阿联酋等中间控股平台，但须确保具备经济实质，避免被认定为规避行为。
analysis.source: 来源：美国财政部投资安全办公室 · 2026年9月
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Expanded US Outbound Investment Screening Requires Chinese Firms to Restructure
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury has proposed broadening outbound investment screening to more transaction types in AI, quantum computing, and hypersonics, while tightening enforcement of the 'knowledge' standard. Chinese companies investing in the US via third-country subsidiaries or forming joint ventures with US entities may trigger filing obligations. Recommendations: (1) conduct look-through reviews of existing and proposed deals to identify sensitive technologies and ultimate beneficiaries; (2) include 'regulatory change' clauses in transaction documents to allocate risk if a deal is blocked; (3) design alternative structures in advance with counsel—such as using Singapore or UAE holding platforms—but ensure economic substance to avoid being deemed circumvention.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Treasury Office of Investment Security · September 2026
